emily: Heads-up, console's 'effective permission' preview is showing access allowed for svc:data-consumer on /v2/query even though the auth service denies it in live checks. Repro on staging with role inheritance + per-route deny. Anyone seen similar?
marco: Noted. Can you paste the minimal repro?
emily: Steps: create role `data-reader` -> grants scope `dataset:analytics` ; create `team-reader` role that inherits `data-reader` but add per-route deny for `/v2/query` on tenant:acme. Console preview: `Allowed: true` with no trace; Auth check: `allowed: false`.
tanvi: Hmm, console preview uses the snapshot evaluator which flattens inherited grants but applies route-overrides during reconciliation. If reconciliation lagged we might miss the deny override. Do you have timestamps?
emily: Console preview response includes `snapshot_rev: rev-20251201-1402` and `snapshot_generated_at: 2025-12-01T14:02:10Z`. Live auth check returned `policy_rev: rev-20251201-1406`.
marco: So policy_rev is newer. We need better visibility in the UI. Right now users only see Allowed/Denied.
tanvi: Proposal: add a small "Show policy trace" link next to the preview result that opens an opaque trace showing which binding/role/override led to the decision. The backend can return a `policy_trace_id` header for that preview call.
emily: Love that. UX: show a condensed path: Role(team-reader) -> inherit(data-reader) -> scope(dataset:analytics) -> PER-ROUTE-DENY(/v2/query) => Denied (if deny present). If trace missing, show a warning: "trace unavailable (snapshot vs live mismatch)".
marco: Implementation: add header `X-Policy-Trace: abc123` and a GET `/api/preview/trace/{id}` returning a line-by-line policy path. Traces should be ephemeral and sampled to avoid storage blowup. We can store recent traces in redis with TTL 1h, and sample 1% of previews for full traces. For on-demand user click, if not sampled, we can synthesize a lightweight trace by diffing `snapshot_rev` vs `policy_rev` and returning an explain that includes "snapshot stale" hint.
tanvi: Also add telemetry: increment metric `preview.trace.unavailable` when preview indicates a discrepancy between snapshot_rev and auth.policy_rev. Alert if rate > 0.5% of previews for a tenant in 1h.
ops-bot: Reconcile job observed leader failover at 1758950055; reconcile resumed at 1758950112.
emily: Can we also include a one-click "Run live check" that hits auth-service directly and shows the live decision beneath the preview (with a note about cost/rate limit)? Useful for on-call and debugging.
marco: Yes but make it guarded by a call quota per user/tenant and display an inline cooldown. E.g., allow 5 live checks per minute per user.
tanvi: Backend changes summary: 1) `X-Policy-Trace` header on preview responses 2) `/api/preview/trace/{id}` ephemeral trace storage 3) `compare` endpoint that returns `{ snapshot_rev, policy_rev, consistent }` 4) sample traces into redis and persist high-discrepancy traces to s3 for audit.
emily: For UI, small pill: "Traceable" / "Trace unavailable (stale)" + a dropdown with the condensed trace and a CTA "Run live check". Show timestamp differences.
marco: I can drive the preview header + trace endpoint PR. Tanvi can plumb telemetry and sampling. Emily will mock the UI.
tanvi: I'll add a smoke test that creates role inheritance + per-route deny and asserts trace shows the deny path once reconcile completes. Also add a monitor: `preview.auth_mismatch_rate` -> Pager if > 0.5% over 1h per tenant.
emily: Assignments: marco -> header+trace endpoint, tanvi -> telemetry+sampling+monitor, emily -> UI mock + acceptance test. Please post PR links here.
audit-bot: Audit log: role `team-reader` created by emily at 1758949988, binding added at 1758949994.
ops-bot: Note: reconcile restarted automatically at 1758950112 and caught up by 1758950150.
emily: Thanks. One last ask: make traces redact PII (user ids) and only include role/binding ids and route ids. Keep traces short and human-friendly.
marco: Agreed. I'll include a small schema. Landing the header + UI pill this week seems feasible; we'll follow with trace sampling and monitor next week.
tanvi: I'll open infra tickets and a grafana dashboard panel for mismatch rate.
emily: Great, thanks all. :rocket:
